items.text: The final deliverable includes an Excel workbook named consolidated_review_harborview_media_group.xlsx.
The workbook includes an Assumptions sheet stating the Q1 2025 reporting period of January 1 through March 31, 2025.
The Assumptions sheet states the CAD-to-USD rate of 0.74.
The Assumptions sheet records Nimue Digital ownership starting February 1, 2025 with a proration factor of approximately 0.6556.
The workbook includes sheets covering Assumptions, Source_Data, Rollup, Reconciliation_Log, and Recommendation.
The Rollup tab reports total consolidated Q1 2025 revenue of approximately $1,590,686.30.
Nimue Digital's Consolidated USD on the Rollup tab is approximately $697,267.02, reflecting about 65.6% proration of its approximately $1,063,627.65 gross figure for the February 1, 2025 acquisition.
Excalibur Creative's Consolidated USD on the Rollup tab is approximately $452,853.28, reflecting CAD-to-USD conversion at the 0.74 period rate.
Lancelot Media's Consolidated USD on the Rollup tab is approximately $440,566.01, with a 100% proration factor reflecting full-quarter ownership.
The Reconciliation_Log documents that void, cancelled, and out-of-period transactions were found and excluded across all three brands.
The Reconciliation_Log identifies excalibur_creative_fx_and_period_reference.txt as the source for the currency conversion rate.
The Reconciliation_Log identifies nimue_digital_acquisition_memo.txt as the source for the acquisition-date proration.
The workbook documents judgment calls where source files disagree, including mid-period acquisition proration and exclusion of non-counting transactions.
The Recommendation sheet states a board-facing recommendation to report the consolidated Q1 2025 figure after FX conversion, exclusions, and Nimue proration.
The Rollup tab Consolidated USD column uses live formulas rather than hard-coded values for derived totals.
The deliverable reports Nimue Digital Consolidated USD on the Rollup tab as equal to its full gross USD figure of approximately $1,063,627.65 with no acquisition-date proration.
The deliverable reports Excalibur Creative Consolidated USD on the Rollup tab as approximately $611,842.27 in unconverted CAD-denominated gross.
The deliverable includes void, cancelled, or post-period transactions in the consolidated Q1 2025 revenue total.
